zones.name: South Desert Dunes & Insertion
zones.description: Player Start Position at (480, 10) behind low desert rock ridges and palm clusters (env_tree_palm_a); approaches to outer adobe wall guarded by Buried Mines M06_T4_01 (415, 175) & M06_T4_02 (545, 185) and Tripwire Alarms M06_T1_01 (350, 195) & M06_T1_02 (620, 195).

zones.name: Outer Industrial Yard & Adobe Perimeter
zones.description: Enclosed by connected 4m adobe walls (env_wall_adobe_4m) and metal watchtowers (env_watchtower_metal_a), patrolled by E2 Cobalt Grunts and E10 Scouts, monitored by exterior cameras M06_CAM_01 and M06_CAM_02.

zones.name: West Fuel Depot — Manifold #1
zones.description: High-voltage Electric Fence M06_T12_01 enclosing large fuel tanks (prop_fuel_tank_large) and Manifold #1 at (265, 490), guarded by E9 Technician #1 and Camera M06_CAM_03.

zones.name: Central Fuel Depot — Manifold #2
zones.description: Protected by Electric Fence M06_T12_02, Motion Sensor M06_T6_01, Heavy Gunner M06_E5_01, E9 Technician #2, Camera M06_CAM_04, and Manifold #2 at (500, 570).

zones.name: East Fuel Depot — Manifold #3
zones.description: Protected by Motion Sensor M06_T6_02, Heavy Gunner M06_E5_02, E9 Technician #3, Camera M06_CAM_05, and Manifold #3 at (770, 520).

zones.name: Central Command & Camera Control Shed
zones.description: Contains Radar Dish Dome (env_radar_dish_dome), Officer quarters (with 2 sector E3 Officers for S2), and Security Control Shed (R1, R2, R3 interior rooms) secured by Alarmed Doors M06_T13_01 & M06_T13_02, Camera M06_CAM_06, Monitor Terminal M06_MON_01 (S1), and T12 generator breaker.

zones.name: North Reserve Motor Pool
zones.description: Northern motor pool staging area supporting cargo vehicles and E13 vehicle crews.

zones.name: East Barracks Camp
zones.description: Eastern adobe garrison barracks compound housing reserve E2 Cobalt squads and Alarm Panel M06_ALM_03.

zones.name: North Reinforcement Road & East Extraction Corridor
zones.description: North highway approach where reinforcement truck spawns at (500, 880) (E_M06_BLAST), connected to East Extraction Road at (980, 600) (radius 10.0m).

primary.title: Plant C4 on all 3 depot manifolds ((265,490), (500,570), (770,520)) & detonate from >50m away

secondary.title: Hack control shed terminal in Zone D to loop all 6 cameras for 60s
Eliminate both sector officers silently (Ghost Medal)

events.description: If Depot 2 (500, 570) is detonated first while alert < 2, a reinforcement cargo truck spawns at (500, 880).

silent.name: Silent Route (Prone Disarm T4 Mine, Unpowered Fence Cut, Silent E9 Elimination & >50m Ridge Detonation)
silent.description: Crawl prone from (480, 10) to disarm Buried Mine M06_T4_01 at (415, 175), cut unpowered West fence section into Zone C1 to silently eliminate E9 Technician #1 and plant C4 on Manifold #1 (265, 490), eliminate E9 Technicians #2 & #3 while planting C4 on Manifold #2 (500, 570) and Manifold #3 (770, 520), detonate remotely from >50m away on the East Extraction Road, and extract at (980, 600).

technical.name: Technical Route (Disarm T13 Alarmed Door, Loop 6 Cameras 60s, Cut T12 Power & EMP T6 Sensors)
technical.description: Advance from (480, 10) into Zone D Security Control Shed (500, 398) by picking/hacking T13 Alarmed Door, hack terminal M06_MON_01 to loop all 6 cameras for 60s (S1) and cut T12 Electric Fence power at M06_PRP_BREAKER_T12, plant C4 on Manifold #1 (265, 490), EMP Motion Sensors M06_T6_01 & M06_T6_02 to plant C4 on Manifold #2 (500, 570) and Manifold #3 (770, 520), and extract at (980, 600).

loud.name: Loud Route (Snipe Sector E3 Officers, Engage E5 Heavy Gunners & Blast All 3 Manifolds)
loud.description: Advance from (480, 10) to overwatch outside Zone D Officer Quarters (390, 345) to eliminate both sector E3 Officers, assault West Depot Manifold #1 (265, 490), engage Heavy Gunners M06_E5_01 & M06_E5_02 from cover to plant and detonate C4 on Manifold #2 (500, 570) and Manifold #3 (770, 520), and exfiltrate to (980, 600).
